rules: Use the earliest supported product announcement, public release or documented product use. Classify it by milestone and exclude map inclusion dates and weak existence clues.
Separate announcement, waitlist, preview and general availability.
Company founding dates and repository creation dates are not product launches.
Retain source URL, event scope, precision and verification date.
A partial shutdown does not remove the entire product.
Keep renames and migrations linked rather than treating them as unrelated launches.
An unknown date remains unknown; do not plot an inferred exact day.
Current logo artwork is used; historical branding is not reconstructed.
next_review: Continue every unresolved inventory record; original launch and full lifecycle remain open even where a later event is verified.
Verify Spark-to-Tasks rename, Siri standalone lineage, and Copilot/Bing Chat lineage.
Resolve original launch dates for historical products; do not infer shutdown from article removal or a redirected domain.
Review remaining founder Show HN posts, repository histories and new-company announcements.
validation: Current logos were matched against the supplied map artwork.
Browser verified six month boundaries, Ollie closure, current and historical tile counts, all 299 logo files loading, and mobile width.
V3 browser check confirmed 318 current products, 325 including historical entries, 25 additions, and all 14 section images. Current logos decoded and existing timeline dates matched the prior audit.

source_collection.note: Collection is not manual verification; unresolved products remain open.

date_coverage_caveat: Placement uses the earliest supported month found, including limited availability, rather than a uniform public launch milestone. Source audits retain evidence quality and event type. The original launch and complete lifecycle remain open for some products.

source_recheck.note: Checked saved claims and searched earlier leads across the inventory. Some sources are unavailable and some earliest or closure dates remain open.
